description: Rewrite all 11 admin views (login + dashboard + 3 category + 3 subcategory + 3 product). Depends on FEAT-001 for x-alert, x-badge, x-empty-state, x-admin.stat-card, x-admin.page-header components.
steps: Rewrite resources/views/admin/auth/login.blade.php — standalone (no @extends). Keep @vite, POST admin.login.post, @csrf, email/password/remember fields, old() values, @error border-red-400 styling. Use <x-alert type='error' :message="session('error')" /> for session error. Use <x-alert type='error' :message="$errors->first()" /> for validation errors inside @if($errors->any()). Design: full-height centered, bg-slate-50, centered card bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg p-8. Brand title + subtitle. Submit button: blue-600.

Rewrite resources/views/admin/dashboard/index.blade.php — @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Dashboard'), @section('page-title','Dashboard'). Variables: $categoryCount, $activeCategoryCount, $subcategoryCount, $productCount, $activeProductCount, $inactiveProductCount. Use 5x <x-admin.stat-card> components in a grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. Stat 1: Total Categories, value=$categoryCount, subtext=$activeCategoryCount.' active', iconBg=bg-blue-100, iconColor=text-blue-600. Stat 2: Subcategories, value=$subcategoryCount, iconBg=bg-violet-100, iconColor=text-violet-600. Stat 3: Total Products, value=$productCount, iconBg=bg-blue-100, iconColor=text-blue-600. Stat 4: Active Products, value=$activeProductCount, iconBg=bg-emerald-100, iconColor=text-emerald-600. Stat 5: Inactive Products, value=$inactiveProductCount, iconBg=bg-red-100, iconColor=text-red-600. Add quick-links row: links to admin.categories.index, admin.subcategories.index, admin.products.index. Welcome card with Auth::user()->name.

Rewrite resources/views/admin/categories/index.blade.php — @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Categories'), @section('page-title','Categories'). Variable: $categories (paginated). Use <x-admin.page-header title='Categories' createRoute='admin.categories.create' createLabel='+ New Category'>. Search form: GET admin.categories.index, input name=search, value=request('search'), clear link when search active. Table: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden; thead bg-slate-50; columns: #, Name, Slug (font-mono text-xs), Subcategories (count), Products (count), Status, Actions. Status column: POST admin.categories.toggleActive($category) form + @csrf + submit button using <x-badge :variant="$category->is_active ? 'emerald' : 'red'" :text="$category->is_active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'">. Edit link: admin.categories.edit($category). Delete: POST admin.categories.destroy($category) + @csrf + @method('DELETE') + onsubmit confirm. Empty via @forelse/@empty using <x-empty-state>. Pagination: $categories->links().

Rewrite resources/views/admin/categories/create.blade.php — @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Create Category'). No controller variables. Form: POST admin.categories.store + @csrf. Fields: name (required, maxlength=100), slug (optional maxlength=120 font-mono, hint 'auto-generated if left blank'), description (textarea rows=3), is_active checkbox (value=1, old('is_active','1') ? 'checked'). All @error('field') with border-red-400 +

. Back link to admin.categories.index. Buttons: blue-600 'Create Category' submit + gray Cancel link. @push('scripts') slug autofill: on #name blur, if #slug empty, set slug.value = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g,'').

Rewrite resources/views/admin/categories/edit.blade.php — @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Edit Category'). Variable: $category. Form: POST admin.categories.update($category) + @csrf + @method('PUT'). Fields pre-populated: old('name',$category->name), old('slug',$category->slug), old('description',$category->description), old('is_active',$category->is_active). Same @error styling. Back link. Same JS slug autofill. Buttons: 'Update Category' + Cancel.

Rewrite resources/views/admin/subcategories/index.blade.php — @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Subcategories'). Variables: $subcategories (paginated with category), $categories. Use <x-admin.page-header title='Subcategories' createRoute='admin.subcategories.create' createLabel='+ New Subcategory'>. Category filter: GET form with select name=category_id, onchange=this.form.submit(), option per $categories, clear link when category_id set. Table columns: #, Name, Category ($subcategory->category->name ?? '—'), Slug, Status, Actions. Status: POST admin.subcategories.toggleActive($subcategory) + @csrf + <x-badge>. Edit/Delete same pattern. Empty state <x-empty-state>. Pagination.

Rewrite resources/views/admin/subcategories/create.blade.php — @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Create Subcategory'). Variable: $categories. Form: POST admin.subcategories.store + @csrf. Fields: category_id select (required, old('category_id')), name (required maxlength=100), slug (optional maxlength=120 font-mono), description (textarea rows=3), is_active checkbox. All @error blocks. Back link. Buttons. @push('scripts') slug autofill.

Rewrite resources/views/admin/subcategories/edit.blade.php — @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Edit Subcategory'). Variables: $subcategory, $categories. Form: POST admin.subcategories.update($subcategory) + @csrf + @method('PUT'). category_id pre-populated: old('category_id',$subcategory->category_id). All fields use old('field',$subcategory->field). Slug autofill JS. Buttons: 'Update Subcategory' + Cancel.

Rewrite resources/views/admin/products/index.blade.php — @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Products'). Variables: $products (paginated with category+subcategory), $categories, $subcategories (may be empty). Filter form: GET admin.products.index — search text (w-52), category_id select, subcategory_id select (id=filter-subcategory), is_active select (All/Active/Inactive), sort select (newest/price_asc/price_desc), Filter button, Clear link when any filter active, '+ New Product' link ml-auto. Table columns: Image(thumbnail 48x48 rounded-lg), Name(truncate max-w-xs), Category, Subcategory, Old Price(right-align ৳), New Price(right-align bold ৳), Status, Actions. Image: @php $thumb = $product->image ? (str_starts_with($product->image,'http') ? $product->image : Storage::disk('public')->url($product->image)) : asset('images/placeholder.png'); @endphp. Status: POST admin.products.toggleActive($product) + @csrf + <x-badge>. Edit/Delete. Empty <x-empty-state>. Pagination. @push('scripts') AJAX subcategory reload: const byCategoryUrl = '{{ route('admin.subcategories.byCategory',['category'=>'__ID__']) }}'; on #filter-category change, fetch url.replace('__ID__',catId), populate #filter-subcategory options.

Rewrite resources/views/admin/products/create.blade.php — @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Create Product'). Variable: $categories. Form: POST admin.products.store + @csrf + enctype=multipart/form-data novalidate. Fields in order: category_id select, subcategory_id select (AJAX-populated, id=subcategory_id), name (maxlength=150, id=name), slug (optional, id=slug), description (textarea rows=4), image file input (id=image, accept=image/jpeg,image/jpg,image/png,image/webp) + hidden preview div (id=image-preview-wrap) with img#image-preview h-32 w-32 rounded-lg, old_price number (min=0 step=0.01 value=old('old_price','0.00')), new_price number, is_active checkbox (checked by default). All old() + @error styling. Back link. Buttons: 'Create Product' + Cancel. @push('scripts') THREE JS behaviors: (1) AJAX subcategory load — const oldCategoryId='{{ old('category_id') }}'; const oldSubcategoryId='{{ old('subcategory_id') }}'; load on page if oldCategoryId set, reload on category change; (2) slug autofill on #name blur; (3) image preview on #image change via FileReader.

Rewrite resources/views/admin/products/edit.blade.php — @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Edit Product'). Variables: $product, $categories, $subcategories. Form: POST admin.products.update($product) + @csrf + @method('PUT') + enctype=multipart/form-data. Fields pre-populated with old('field',$product->field). Current image: if $product->image, show @php $currentThumb = str_starts_with($product->image,'http') ? $product->image : Storage::disk('public')->url($product->image); @endphp + img h-24 w-24 + 'upload to replace' hint. New image preview div. Prices: old('old_price',$product->old_price) and old('new_price',$product->new_price). is_active: old('is_active',$product->is_active). @push('scripts') THREE JS behaviors: (1) AJAX on category change — const currentCategoryId='{{ old('category_id',$product->category_id) }}'; const currentSubcategoryId='{{ old('subcategory_id',$product->subcategory_id) }}'; (2) slug autofill; (3) image preview.
acceptance_criteria: All 11 admin view files are rewritten
Dashboard uses x-admin.stat-card for all 5 stats
All index pages use x-admin.page-header, x-badge for status, x-empty-state for empty rows
All create/edit forms preserve @csrf, old() values, @error displays, and correct route() targets
Product create/edit has AJAX subcategory load + slug autofill + image preview JS
php artisan test --compact passes all 55 tests
